title: Composite Lighting with Light Streaks in Photoshop — Day 30 (PHLEARN)
summary: PHLEARN’s Day 30 lesson closes the 30 Days of Photoshop series with a final composite project. The instructor imports a subject image and a collection of light-streak assets, then builds a layered, lighting-rich composite using non-destructive workflows: smart objects and smart filters, layer masks, and a variety of blend modes (notably Screen). The process involves masking the subject, duplicating and repositioning light layers, and experimenting with color and exposure through Levels adjustments on RGB channels. A Camera Raw finish (radial gradient, vignette, grain) and a lens blur pass further integrate the lighting with the subject, while techniques like applying images and copying smart filters across layers keep edits flexible. The video emphasizes experimentation and play, with downloadables and a reminder that all steps can be adjusted or undone for different artistic outcomes.

sections.title: Intro and asset import
sections.description: Aaron introduces the final project, selects a subject image, and imports multiple light-streak assets as smart objects to preview a lighting-based composite using Screen blend mode.

sections.title: Masking fundamentals with Select Subject
concepts: Linking vs unlinking layer and mask
sections.description: Uses Select Subject to generate a mask for lighting layers, then demonstrates the relationship between layers and their masks, including linking and unlinking to move them independently and invert the mask when needed.

sections.title: Building the initial composite with light layers
sections.description: Adds additional light layers, applies Screen blending, and uses transform and duplication to position lights around the subject to begin the composite narrative.

sections.title: Color experiments and advanced blending
sections.description: Explores color shaping by adjusting Levels on smart objects and selectively editing RGB channels to shift color balance, while duplicating and rearranging layers and employing inverted masks for varied effects.

sections.title: Camera Raw finish and depth of field
sections.description: Applies a Camera Raw finish with radial masking to brighten the subject and darken the background, adds grain, and uses lens blur to blend lighting with depth cues for a photographic finish.

sections.title: Final polish and resources
sections.description: Demonstrates applying edits to a new version via Apply Image, copying smart filters between smart objects, and points to free resources (sample images and PSD) as the series concludes.
